home.about.title: Who am I?
home.about.p1: I'm a Visual Development Artist and a Roblox developer from Brazil since 2020, creating and contributing to the platform since 2020. I specialized in 3D Modeling, Game, Graphic, and UI/UX Design, helping bring ideas from concept to reality.
home.about.p2: Beyond just building, I led game jam teams and coordinate communities, working to make every collaborative creation an inclusive and welcoming space for everyone involved. I also produce concept art to spark creativity and help define the better direction and ideas behind the games I worked on.
home.skills.title: Creative Toolkit

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.cryptHunter.title: Crypt Hunter
portfolio.cryptHunter.description: Exploration adventure set in a mysterious temple, where the player tries to recover a legendary gem and escape. Awarded 2nd place in the Most Innovative Gameplay category at Inspire 2026.
portfolio.cryptHunter.role: 2D Concept Artist, Storyboard Artist, and Game Design Collaborator.
portfolio.connectionFailure.title: Connection Failure
portfolio.connectionFailure.description: A post-apocalyptic survival game where you drive through an abandoned desert, collect batteries to power radio towers, and protect your bus from evil machines trying to destroy you. Awarded 3rd place at Connect 2022.
portfolio.rainbowFriends.title: Rainbow Friends
portfolio.rainbowFriends.summary: Cooperative survival experience set in a mascot-themed horror world, where players must work together to escape mysterious creatures.
portfolio.rainbowFriends.details: Rainbow Friends is a cooperative survival experience where players work together while trying to escape mysterious creatures.
portfolio.rainbowFriends.testing: Survival gameplay, player objectives, and feedback.
portfolio.unnaturalDisaster.title: Unnatural Disaster Survival
portfolio.unnaturalDisaster.summary: Disaster survival game with challenges, hidden puzzles, and combined disasters
portfolio.unnaturalDisaster.details: Disaster survival game where players face UFOs, zombies, storms, super villains, and more while exploring a magical island. Players can complete challenges, discover hidden puzzles, and survive combined disasters.
portfolio.unnaturalDisaster.testing: Disaster combinations, challenge progression, and bug reporting.
portfolio.superSkyward.title: Super Skyward Towers
portfolio.superSkyward.summary: Parkour tower game featuring jumps, pets, abilities, and challenging obstacles
portfolio.superSkyward.details: Parkour tower game where players use double jumps, wall jumps, pets, and other abilities to overcome obstacles and climb increasingly difficult towers.
portfolio.superSkyward.testing: Movement abilities, obstacle collisions, and tower progression.
portfolio.eggHunt.title: Egg Hunt 2022: Lost In Time
portfolio.eggHunt.summary: What-if Egg Hunt adventure with exploration, missions, and in-game UGC-style rewards
portfolio.eggHunt.details: Project created by @DeepAquaticBlue and @InnovativeTime as a what-if continuation of Roblox Egg Hunt events. Players explored, completed missions, and earned UGC-style rewards that stayed in-game.
portfolio.eggHunt.role: Volunteer QA Tester with the Valiant Community QA Team.
portfolio.eggHunt.testing: World 1's environment, gameplay mechanics, user interfaces, and bug reporting.
portfolio.roTubeLife.title: RoTube Life!
portfolio.roTubeLife.summary: Creator simulation about recording videos, upgrading your setup, and becoming a famous RoTuber
portfolio.roTubeLife.details: Life-simulation experience where players grow from a small creator into a famous RoTuber by recording videos, upgrading their setup, earning awards, and building a headquarters.
portfolio.roTubeLife.testing: In-game bugs, interactive features, and player-facing functions.
portfolio.roBattle.title: RoBattle.io
portfolio.roBattle.summary: 100-player Roblox battle experience created for the LazarBeam event
portfolio.roBattle.details: RoBattle.io is a Roblox experience created by the RB Battles Games team for the LazarBeam event, where 100 players battle against one another.
portfolio.roBattle.testing: In-game bugs, gameplay systems, and feedback to improve the player experience.
portfolio.strangerThings.title: Stranger Things: Starcourt Mall
portfolio.strangerThings.summary: Roblox event experience where players completed quests to earn prizes
portfolio.strangerThings.details: Roblox event experience made through a Wizards of the Coast LLC and Netflix partnership, where players completed quests for event prizes.
portfolio.strangerThings.role: Volunteer QA Tester on the Valiant Community QA Team, run by former Roblox employee @Hippie_ofDoom.
portfolio.strangerThings.testing: Gameplay mechanics, bug reporting, and testing the experience before its full release on Roblox.
portfolio.uiux.interfaceDescription: Simple and readable screens for players
portfolio.uiux.playerDescription: Layouts and flows that are easy to understand
portfolio.listou.title: Listōu
portfolio.listou.description: A task and list management app designed from scratch using computational thinking principles, featuring statistics, meetings, chat, group management, and AI-powered accessibility.
portfolio.listou.fullDescription: Listōu is a collaborative task and list management app designed from scratch in approximately a week. Built on computational thinking pillars, the app helps teams and individuals stay organized through a clean and intuitive interface.
portfolio.listou.projectNote: Complete name, color palette, page structures, and functionalities were designed by me using computational thinking principles.
portfolio.lastOucome.title: The Last Outcome
portfolio.lastOucome.description: Cooperative asymmetrical game based on Outcome Memories with original twists, character designs, and maps. I volunteered to handle the UI section, ensuring modern and simple visuals for easy player navigation.
portfolio.lastOucome.fullDescription: The Last Outcome is a cooperative asymmetrical game inspired by Outcome Memories, featuring original twists on gameplay, character designs, and maps. I volunteered to handle the UI section, ensuring the visuals were simple and modernized for easy player navigation. All references were based on the original game, polished with simplicity.
portfolio.hammerSmasherUI.title: Hammer Smasher
portfolio.hammerSmasherUI.description: Game jam project from Inspire 2025. As Art Director, I developed user interfaces matching the color palette and created 100+ icons in both flat and stylized versions.
portfolio.hammerSmasherUI.fullDescriptio: Hammer Smasher was a game jam project for Inspire 2025. As Art Director, I developed user interfaces that matched the game's color palette and created over 100 icons in both flat and stylized versions. Not all of the UI assets made it into the final build, but they were stored internally for potential future use.
portfolio.hammerSmasherUI.projectNote: This project is also featured in the Roblox Projects section with its full game thumbnail.
portfolio.chopAndClockUI.title: Chop & Clock!
portfolio.chopAndClockUI.description: Game jam project from Inspire 2024. As Art Director, I created user interfaces with a pastel color palette to make the game more enjoyable while keeping visuals simple.
portfolio.chopAndClockUI.fullDescription: Chop & Clock! was a game jam project for Inspire 2024. As Art Director, I created user interfaces with a pastel color palette to make the game more enjoyable while keeping the visuals simple and approachable. Not all of the UI designs made it into the final build, but they were stored internally for future reference.
portfolio.chopAndClockUI.projectNote: This project is also featured in the Roblox Projects section with its full game thumbnail.
portfolio.conceptArt.cryptHunter.title: Crypt Hunter
portfolio.conceptArt.cryptHunter.descrip: During the development of Crypt Hunter, I helped the team with my concept art skills. This exploration adventure is set in a mysterious temple, where I created concept art for environments, storyboard sequences, and more, helping shape ideas and final designs.
portfolio.conceptArt.cryptHunter.role: 2D Concept Artist, Environment Concept Artist, and Storyboard Artist.
portfolio.conceptArt.cryptHunter.project: You can find the playable project in the Roblox Projects tab.
portfolio.art3d.modelsDescription: Three-dimensional assets for games and scenes
portfolio.art3d.environmentDescription: Props and spaces built for atmosphere
portfolio.lastOutcome3d.title: The Last Outcome
portfolio.lastOutcome3d.description: Co-op asymmetrical game inspired by Outcome Memories. I retopologized all unoptimized character models down to ~12k triangles each for better performance.
portfolio.lastOutcome3d.fullDescription: The Last Outcome is a co-op asymmetrical game inspired by Outcome Memories. All character models I received were unoptimized, so I retopologized them to a maximum of ~12k triangles each. This significantly improved game performance while keeping the visual quality intact.
portfolio.onHiatus.title: Unnamed Project (Second Owner & Lead 3D Artist)
portfolio.onHiatus.description: As second owner, I ensured the project followed specific direction while being the sole 3D modeler — creating all weapons based on classic Roblox gears and custom models. Project paused but may resume later.
portfolio.onHiatus.fullDescription: As the second owner of this project, I was responsible for ensuring it followed a specific creative direction. I was also the sole 3D modeler, creating all weapons based on classic Roblox gears and fully custom models. The project is currently on hold, but there are plans to potentially resume it in the future. All completed assets are archived and ready for reuse.
portfolio.hammerSmasher3d.title: Hammer Smasher
portfolio.hammerSmasher3d.description: As Art Director & Environment Artist, I built most environment props: computers, chairs, and the Roblox HQ modeled from a single reference photo, all in low poly style.
portfolio.hammerSmasher3d.fullDescriptio: As Art Director and Environment Artist for Hammer Smasher (Inspire 2025 challenge), I created the majority of environment props. This included computers, office chairs, and the Roblox Headquarters building, modeled after the real-life building using only a single angled reference photo. All assets used a low poly style for performance and visual clarity.
portfolio.discontinuedProject.title: Discontinued Project
portfolio.discontinuedProject.descriptio: A solo Christmas event project inspired by The Classic. I designed and modeled all interactive creations myself. Discontinued due to being a solo project, but all assets are saved for future use.
portfolio.discontinuedProject.fullDescri: This was a solo project meant to be a Christmas event inspired by The Classic. I handled everything from concept to 3D modeling of all interactive assets. Without additional team members for programming and other roles, the project had to be discontinued. However, all 3D assets were carefully archived and can be repurposed for future projects.
portfolio.chopAndClock3d.title: Chop & Clock!
portfolio.chopAndClock3d.description: As Art Director & Lead 3D Artist, I created modular kitchen/restaurant assets inspired by Ukrainian restaurants and modern kitchens for a game jam. Unused assets were saved for later.
portfolio.chopAndClock3d.fullDescription: As Art Director and Lead 3D Artist for Chop & Clock! (Unite 2024 game jam), I focused on creating modular assets for kitchen and restaurant environments, drawing inspiration from Ukrainian restaurants and modern kitchen designs. The modular approach allowed flexible level design. Not all models made it into the final game, but everything was completed and archived for future use.
portfolio.billSimulationEscape.descripti: Action-adventure game where players control Bill, a test subject trapped in a collapsing simulation, created for the Inspire 2024 challenge. Navigate through 5 levels filled with time manipulation and gravity reversal challenges, reach the reactor room, and shut it down before the simulation fails completely.
portfolio.billSimulationEscape.title: BillSimulationEscape
portfolio.chopAndClock.description: Chop & Clock is a restaurant management game where players work as a chef in Lviv, Ukraine, created for the Unite 2024. Serve delicious dishes to satisfy hungry customers while completing special challenges and timed tasks.
portfolio.chopAndClock.role: Art Director and 3D Artist / Lead Artist.
portfolio.chopAndClock.title: Chop & Clock!
portfolio.hammerSmasher.description: 2.5D action-RPG created for the Inspire 2025 challenge where you start at Roblox Headquarters and must stop evil NPCs from destroying everything using the ban hammer, a versatile tool. Battle through the facility and defeat 1x1x1x1, the final boss, at the data center.
portfolio.hammerSmasher.title: Hammer Smasher
portfolio.kilonova.description: Massive space station designed entirely with primitive parts for the Roblox Enseña & Aprende challenge. Players navigate the station, disable tower connections, find the communication room, and escape before a Kilonova explosion destroys it.
portfolio.kilonova.title: Kilonova
portfolio.originOfTheGifts.description: Holiday runway environment where Santa's sleigh can take off and land, designed using Toolbox assets and UGC accessories to create a complete, thematic build. Winner of the Construção category at "Desafio de Natal" 2020.
portfolio.originOfTheGifts.title: Origin of the Gifts
